name: shopsmart-ai
description: ShopSmart AI monorepo: React 19 + Vite frontend, Express + TypeScript API, MongoDB (Atlas Search + Vector Search), NVIDIA models

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/frontend exec tsc -- -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit
